column1: # It is in the configuration this repository recommends, and it was tuned on
# fp-bench rather than on this corpus. On drivers where STP loses to Bitwuzla
# it is a 4x to 5.5x penalty -- atan2 is 14.92s with it and 3.23s without, on
# identical work -- but that sample was chosen for being losses. Two drivers
# gain about 15% from it and bli_gemv is 2.44x worse without it, so the
# question needs the unbiased corpus rather than the interesting end of it.
